frontier.hypothesis: The `nop` at slot 126 is the whole 216-vs-215 delta, and it is a reorg delay-slot-fill decision that target makes and we decline; making it puts the 23-floor body at 215 insns with cluster C already closed.
frontier.mechanism: reorg's steal-from-branch-target fill. On the 25-floor body reorg stole `li v1,1` into the delay slot of `beqz v0,<globals block>`; on the 23-floor body the candidate is `li v0,1`, a write of the register the branch itself reads, and reorg refuses - probably a conservative resource conflict in resource.c. Target performs the identical steal (`beqz v0,.L800285DC` + `addiu v0,zero,1`), so it is reachable in this compiler.
frontier.next_probe: Read reorg.c / resource.c in tools/gcc-2.7.2 around fill_simple_delay_slots and steal_delay_list_from_target, and if the refusal is not obvious from the source, instrument the fill the way s8 instrumented find_cross_jump (the isolate.py / dumpiso.sh recipe in tmp/grind/func_800283D0/s9/ is ready to reuse). If it is a conflict with the branch's own condition register, the C question becomes: what source shape makes the globals block's first insn something other than a write of that register - e.g. leading with the `lui`/store of a global whose value is not in v0.

frontier.hypothesis: Cluster B (slots 45/47) yields to the exit-form dimension that s9 just proved is worth several slots and is decided independently per exit site.
frontier.mechanism: Each inline `return ret;` creates a block-local (set (reg/i:SI 2 v0) ...) that sched1 places and that later passes may or may not cross-jump into a shared exit block; a `goto` to a shared labelled return does not. Target's `.L80028488` is a LABELLED shared `j / li v0,1` block with three early-exit predecessors (s6), which is exactly what a particular assignment of goto-vs-return over our four early-exit sites would produce.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate the exit-form assignments over the four early-exit sites (range-check exit, temp_v1_2 == 0xE, do_calls, globals block) - s9 measured only two of the sixteen - and measure each with sandbox --disable all, recording build_insns alongside the score. s1 pinned the range-check exit to an INLINE return and s9 pinned the globals block to a goto, so the live search is over the remaining two sites crossed with re-testing those two pins on the 23-floor body.
